# Medellín Concierge

> Medellín Concierge S.A.S. is a property management company in Medellín, Colombia, managing Airbnb / short-term and long-term rentals for local and foreign owners in El Poblado, Laureles, Envigado and Sabaneta. Bilingual team (English and Spanish), office in El Poblado.

## Key facts

- Services: Property management, Airbnb management, Short-term rental management, Long-term rental management, Channel management, Vacation rental management
- Areas served: Medellín, El Poblado, Laureles, Envigado, Sabaneta, Colombia
- Fees: Basic plan 12% + IVA of rental income for long stays (30+ nights), 17% + IVA for short stays; Premium plan 15% + IVA long stays, 20% + IVA short stays. No upfront fees. Premium also pays the owner's property tax, HOA fees, utilities and internet, with a monthly accounting report.
- Office: Cl. 10 #42-28, Oficina 15, El Poblado, Medellín, Antioquia, Colombia (https://maps.app.goo.gl/Z1Edu7BPoXGiPpqh8)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +57 304 277 3864
- Email: sales@medellinconcierge.net
- NIT (Colombian tax ID): 901564260-7
- Website (English): https://www.medellinconcierge.net/ | Spanish: https://www.medellinconcierge.net/es/
- Profiles: https://www.airbnb.com/users/show/446836447, https://www.instagram.com/medellin.concierge/, https://maps.app.goo.gl/Z1Edu7BPoXGiPpqh8, https://www.facebook.com/luxmedellinconcierge, https://www.linkedin.com/company/medellin-concierge-sas/
